llm_boxed_warning: Fetal toxicity: discontinue losartan potassium when pregnancy is detected because drugs acting on the renin‑angiotensin system can cause injury or death to the developing fetus.
llm_safety_summary: Losartan potassium carries a fetal‑toxicity boxed warning, and the most frequently reported adverse events in FAERS include fatigue, diarrhea, nausea, dizziness, and cough.
